refloor.why: sheet_proxy floored the cloak-wing TIPS (behind the body, x +-1.5..1.9, y 1.4..2.0, z 0.00); the talons hang 0.096 u above them. The floor goes to the lowest TALON contact (the toes, y -1.25..-0.2, |x| 0.15..1.2), then x(6.84 / proxy height) to the sheet front height

dense.why: the skull helmet: beak, eye sockets, horns (vg_weight 0.3 so the two eye boxes below can sit denser; the calibration still gives the boxes 2.5 x the rest: share 0.1925)
the right eye socket (x -0.207): held denser (vg_weight 0) so the glow core and the dark rim land on separate faces: 41-45 faces within 0.11 u of each socket centre (was 9-10)
the left eye socket (x 0.357): held denser (vg_weight 0) so the glow core and the dark rim land on separate faces: 41-45 faces within 0.11 u of each socket centre (was 9-10)
v2.1: the chest skull pendant held as dense as the eye sockets: at 38 faces the decimated pendant lost its sockets and fused with the cord strap at its upper right (the glowing 'flap')

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the feather soup has inner shells that black-hole AO rays (crystal_canine lesson)

floor_lift.why: after the refloor to the talons the cloak-wing hem behind the body (|x| 1.5..1.9, y 1.4..2.0) hangs 0.1 u below the floor (the sheet draws it past the floor line); it is squashed up onto z 0 within the bottom 0.45 u, the feet (|x| < 1.2, y < 0.95) keep weight 0

recolour3d.name: skull_bone
recolour3d.why: spec: weathered CREAM bone helmet (sheet chip 223,204,183); the proxy's skull bakes tan / peach (median 191,155,126): bone texels (L* >= 35, b* >= 7) recoloured to the chip, the proxy's shading kept as a luminance ratio

recolour3d.name: pendant_bone
recolour3d.why: v2.1 (coordinator: the skull must read first): the chest pendant stays the cream bone chip 223,204,183 (proxy median 199,161,129)

recolour3d.name: pendant_sockets_dark
recolour3d.why: the pendant's own eye sockets (front ortho x -0.081 / 0.169, z 3.925, mirrored about its centre x 0.044; side y -1.0) made hollow and dark like the helmet's

recolour3d.name: eye_sockets
recolour3d.why: artist: hollow DARK eye sockets, glow NONE: the proxy's grey eyeballs (front ortho x -0.21 / 0.36, z 5.88; side y -1.30 = 0.87 u behind the beak tip, where the sheet side view draws its one socket) and the teal glow around them painted near-black; bone (b* > 7) keeps its colour

recolour3d.name: eye_glow_core
recolour3d.why: artist v1 verdict: 'green glow in the eyes': the socket centres (the proxy's eyeballs, front ortho x -0.207 / 0.357, z 5.88) painted the spirit sheet's eye-glow green (front-view eye pixels, top-saturation median 156,234,161) after the hue clamp; the dark socket rim (eye_sockets, r 0.17) and the bone (b* > 7) stay

recolour3d.name: upper_recess_to_bone
recolour3d.why: the proxy invented a SECOND recess per side above / behind the eye (y -1.07, z 6.11) filled with teal glow; the sheet's side view has one socket per side, so the recess is painted bone (a shade under the chip: it is a hollow) instead of a second dark hole

recolour3d.name: wrappings_to_feathers
recolour3d.why: artist: extras = the skull pendant on a cord ONLY: the brown cloth wrappings hanging under the pendant (front ortho x -0.3..0.4, z 2.2..4.4) and the brown belly panel between the legs (z 0.4..2.0) repainted as black feathers (proxy median feather 37,36,34); the pendant (excluded box) and the dark cord stay

recolour3d.name: neck_shoulder_strips
recolour3d.why: the proxy's red-brown strips on the neck behind the skull (x +-0.4, y -0.44, z 5.7; median 64,30,23) and on the shoulder tops (x +-0.9, z 4.75; median 72,52,41) are the spirit sheet's cloth wrappings: repainted as black feathers (the dark cord + beads are not red-brown and stay)

recolour3d.name: pendant_faint_cast
recolour3d.why: a FAINT green cast on the pendant bone (18 % toward the spirit green-bone), after the clamp: the bone still reads cream

recolour3d.name: pendant_socket_cores
recolour3d.why: the spectre glow sits in the pendant's sockets: small green cores (r 0.03) inside the dark sockets (r 0.05), the helmet eye green

tint_clamp.why: NO GREEN anywhere: a* raised to -1 on every texel (the build sheet's own 10th percentile a* is -1.3; the proxy had 10.4 % of samples below -3, 24 % on the legs), L* kept
the legs: scaly GREY-BROWN (spec), not teal-grey: a* >= 1, b* >= 4 on the shins / toes, L* kept

light.bake_drop_interior_why: v1 first run: the albedo bake (cage 0.42 u = 3 x the proxy-to-low p99 0.139) printed dark blotches on the skull / beak / pendant from the proxy's inner shells (the inside of the helmet shell, buried feather layers); proxy faces with solid on both sides are left out of the bake source (crystal_canine lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: v1 run 3: AO from the low with the world's default ray length occluded the whole feather cloak (AO median 0.20, 31 % of texels under 0.1): basecolor median (17,15,15) vs the proxy albedo (50,47,45) and the sheet feathers (~35); AO limited to 0.6 u (about two feather lengths) so only real crevices darken
light.uv_island_margin_why: the feather low unwraps into ~6200 islands; at the default 0.003 margin (6 px at 2048) the atlas held 4.7 % texels (check uv_health coverage 0.047): margin 0.001 (2 px at 2048, 1 px at the 1024 normal / AO) so the albedo keeps its detail

glow3d.name: eyes_core
glow3d.why: the eye glow: faces of the socket centres -> region eye_glow (emission 156,234,161 x 1.0)

glow3d.name: eyes_halo
glow3d.why: a faint halo on the dark socket faces just around the core (eye_glow_halo, x 0.35, out to 0.12 u); the outer socket rim (to 0.17 u) stays dark and unlit; bone faces (baked L* > 55) excluded so the bone stays cream

glow3d.name: pendant_sockets
glow3d.why: the pendant's socket cores -> pendant_eye_glow (156,234,161 x 0.8); the bone face is NOT emissive so the skull reads

glow3d.name: pendant_socket_halo
glow3d.why: v2.1: a faint halo on the dark socket faces around each pendant core (the helmet's eye_glow_halo, x 0.35). A rim glow on the dark faces around the pendant outline was tried (pendant_rim_glow x 0.15, 191 faces) and dropped: the large feather faces behind the pendant lit as flat green panels and fought the skull read

chains.name: wing
chains.why: the draped cloak wings: shoulder (x 0.75, z 5.0) down the outer feather mass (slab medians x 1.3, y 0.3..0.9) to the hem behind the feet; 3 bones per side

chains.name: leg
chains.why: thigh (inside the feathers) / shin (the visible scaly tarsus: slab medians x +-0.45, y 0.05..0.27 at z 0.6..1.2) / foot to the middle toe

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (OPEN-QUESTIONS N15: movement + height open). idle = breathe 1.5 deg + the kit's cloak-wing sway; walk = a short stalk-step (leg swing 10 deg: at 14 the kit's foot bend dipped the toes 0.44 u below the floor)
